name: Laws of Andorra (the Constitution and the laws of the Consell General), as enacted
label: Andorra
record_note: 1041 texts from the Butlletí Oficial del Principat d'Andorra (the Constitution and 1040 laws, published 1989-01-29 to 2026-10-28), each as enacted, dated by its entry into force; amendments are not applied (they are listed in data/amendments.csv). Retrieved 2026-10-29, built 2026-10-29.

dates.commit: in-force (the law's own entry-into-force provision, counted from its BOPA publication date; else fifteen days after publication, Codi de l'Administracio 1989 art. 9)

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Andorra; transitional provisions are in each law

default_reach.meaning: the Constitution guarantees the principle of the non-retroactivity of provisions that restrict individual rights or that impose a penalty; otherwise a law applies from its entry into force unless it says so

citation.note: article numbers within the same law ("article 25", "articles 25 i 26" match only the first); a later law's reference to an article of another law is not resolved
